title: LED current limiting
description: Drive an LED from a 9V supply. The netlist must contain exactly: 'V1 vin 0 DC 9' (supply), 'Rsense vin sense 1' (a 1 ohm current-sense resistor in series with the supply), and 'Vled led_a 0 DC 2' (the LED modeled as a fixed 2V forward drop from node 'led_a' to ground). Add a current-limiting resistor from 'sense' to 'led_a' so the LED current is between 15mA and 20mA, i.e. the drop across Rsense is between 0.015V and 0.020V. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
